# validatestring
g01 | validatestring('app',{'apple','banana'})
g02 | validatestring('APP',{'apple'})
g03 | validatestring('a',{'apple','apricot'})
g04 | validatestring('app',{'apple','applesauce'})
g05 | validatestring('x',{'apple','banana'})
g06 | validatestring('x',{'apple','banana'},'myfun','mode')
g07 | validatestring('x',{'apple','banana'},'myfun','mode',2)
g08 | validatestring(5,{'apple'})
g09 | validatestring('apple',{'apple','applesauce'})
